$comment: Maps React Spectrum S2 Button story args to the foundation button recipe options (packages/design-data/visuals/button.json). A null value means the recipe has no equivalent; such states are not rendered and are reported as unmapped. The Example story renders six Buttons; a layout picks one: label-only is the first, icon-label the second (leading icon + text).

notArgs.children / icon: Slot content, not an arg. The recipe has an icon option and always draws an icon part; layouts pick the S2 button with or without an icon.
notArgs.RAC interaction states (hover, pressed,: Not args. Recipe states are hover, down, keyboard-focus; not captured in this pilot.
notArgs.styles / UNSAFE_style / UNSAFE_className: S2 style escape hatches and pending content have no recipe option.
